patterns.hintFULL_HOUSE: Every number on the card — the complete 24-number house.
patterns.hintHALF_HOUSE: Any full half of the card: three rows, three columns, or either side of either diagonal — fifteen cells.
patterns.hintEIGHT_LINES: Three rows, three columns and both diagonals.
patterns.hintSEVEN_LINES: Three rows, two columns and both diagonals.
patterns.hintSIX_LINES: The top three rows, the first two columns and one diagonal.
patterns.hintFIVE_LINES: The top three rows, the left column and one diagonal.
patterns.TWO_VERT_TWO_HORIZ_ONE_DIAG: Two Vertical + Two Horizontal + One Diagonal
patterns.hintTWO_VERT_TWO_HORIZ_ONE_DIAG: Those two short columns, extended into a diagonal.
patterns.hintTWO_VERT_TWO_HORIZ: The top and bottom rows, plus the first two full columns.
patterns.hintTWO_VERT_THREE_HORIZ: The first two columns plus the top row and the bottom two rows.
patterns.FIVE_LINES_NO_FREE: Five Lines Not Touching the Free Space
patterns.hintFIVE_LINES_NO_FREE: The top two rows, the bottom row and both edge columns — none of them needs the free centre.
patterns.FOUR_LINES_NO_FREE: Four Lines Not Touching the Free Space
patterns.hintFOUR_LINES_NO_FREE: The top two rows, the bottom row and the left column — none of them needs the free centre.
patterns.TWO_TOUCH_TWO_NO_TOUCH: Two Lines Touching the Free Space + Two Lines Not Touching the Free Space
patterns.hintTWO_TOUCH_TWO_NO_TOUCH: The top and bottom rows stay clear of the free cell, while the middle row and middle column run through it.
patterns.hintFOUR_SQUARES: A small square in each corner of the card.
patterns.hintTWO_LINES_TWO_SQUARES: The top and bottom rows, each with a small square attached on the left.
patterns.TWO_LINES_TWO_SEP_SQUARES: Two Disconnected Lines + Two Disconnected Squares
patterns.hintTWO_LINES_TWO_SEP_SQUARES: The first and last columns, plus two small squares along the top.
patterns.hintTHREE_SQUARES_FOUR_DOTS: Three corner squares plus four scattered cells, one of them the free centre.
patterns.hintTHREE_RECTANGLES: A long bar across the top, middle and bottom of the card.
patterns.hintLARGE_T_TWO_LINES: A wide T across the top with its stem running down the middle.
patterns.hintFOUR_LINES: The top two rows, the left column and the right column.
patterns.hintTHREE_LINES_ONE_DIAG: The top two rows, the bottom row and the main diagonal.
patterns.FOUR_LINES_TOUCH_FREE: Four Lines Touching the Free Space
patterns.hintFOUR_LINES_TOUCH_FREE: A dense cross that surrounds the free centre from every side.
patterns.hintTWO_LINES_TWO_RECTANGLES: The top and bottom rows, plus the left and right columns.
patterns.hintLARGE_T_THREE_LINES: A wide T across the top with a full row at the bottom.
patterns.TWO_HORIZ_TWO_VERT_TWO_DIAG: Two Horizontal + Two Vertical + Two Diagonal Lines
patterns.hintTWO_HORIZ_TWO_VERT_TWO_DIAG: The top and bottom rows, both edge columns and both diagonals.
patterns.THREE_LINES_NO_FREE_DISJOINT: Three Disconnected Lines Not Touching the Free Space
patterns.hintTHREE_LINES_NO_FREE_DISJOINT: The top two rows and the bottom row — never through the free centre.
patterns.FOUR_LINES_NO_FREE_DISJOINT: Four Disconnected Lines Not Touching the Free Space
patterns.hintFOUR_LINES_NO_FREE_DISJOINT: All four edges of the card.
patterns.THREE_SMALL_T: Two Small T Shapes + a Line all Disconnected
patterns.hintTHREE_SMALL_T: Two small T shapes plus one full line.
patterns.hintLARGE_CROSS_TWO_SQUARES: A full cross through the middle row and column, with a square in the top-left and another in the bottom-right corner.
patterns.THREE_SMALL_CROSSES: Two Small Crosses + a Line all Disconnected
patterns.hintTHREE_SMALL_CROSSES: Two small crosses plus one full line.
